title: YouTube creator metadata exposed private email addresses
product: YouTube Studio and Content ID APIs
summary: A cross-API privacy finding received a USD 20,000 award after a documented adjustment.
root_cause: Inconsistent field-level access controls exposed private creator metadata across related APIs.
impact: Private email addresses associated with monetized channels could be disclosed.
defensive_takeaways: Apply field-level authorization consistently across APIs.
Treat cross-service identifiers as data, never as proof of entitlement.

reward.notes: USD 13,337 initial award plus USD 6,663 adjustment for this same report; awarded date records the final adjustment.
